scdc21f495e60fd: As machine learning and artificial intelligence loads enter Kubernetes environment, traditional whole-card distribution can easily result in accelerator resource fragments and underutilization. Hami develops research around the particle size of heterogeneous accelerators such as GPU, running-time solvation and equipment awarenessScheduling, enabling multiple taskloads to share acceleration without modifying their application codes and existing Kubernetes lists.
s3330b08f4441d5: HAMi, with the co-sponsorship of Zhang Zhang Chou, Mengxuan Li and global developers, has been developing a sustainable open source from a GPU shared and scheduling technology programme to evolve the middle between the claud-nativevirtualization and scheduling in support of various heterogeneous accelerators.
sef79dad499f89e: In March 2020, the HAMi project first submitted codes for early technical exploration around GPU sharing and scheduling in the Kubernetes environment, which led to the gradual development of virtualization and scheduling capabilities for heterogeneous accelerators.
sac9c8c5d0f0aee: On 21 August 2024, Hami was accepted by the CNCF as Sandbox project and began to promote open governance, technological evolution and ecological construction within the framework of the CNCF.
sdee70c54d6cdd5: On 2 July 2026, the CNCF Technical Supervisory Committee voted in hatching voting for HAMi to be promoted to the CNCF Incubating Project. The CNCF bulletin shows that the project has met requirements at the technical, safety, community governance, production adoption and ecological integration stages and formed a multi-organizational donor base.

s3cf2cf64cecc60: HAMi supports the application of accelerator resources by GPU memory, calculating core and equipment volumes, and provides a strategy for scheduling such as concentration, dispersion and increased awareness. The project reduces differences in the way different hardware is managed and carried by loads of work, through a unified Kubernetes interface with multiple heterogeneous accelerators.
sf014f679c4fffc: The project uses open-source community collaboration models, which are hosted by CNCF and governed by the principle of vendor neutrality. The project involves code contributions, problem tracking, release of versions and technical collaboration through an open-code warehouse where community participants can participate in project construction through Issue, Pull Request and community meetings.
s8ba536a8210b91: The project governance document shows that the current core maintainers (Comitters) are from Dynamia, NVIDIA, Model IV and independent developers; among them, the project sponsors Zhang Chang-Chu and Mengxuan Li are currently all from Dynamia. The multi-organization structure of the maintainers reflects the principles of vendor neutrality in the framework of the CNCF.
sd273a0efdce064: HAMi provides resource management capabilities for Kubernetes ecology and integrates or collaborates with Scheduling, such as Volcano, Koordinator, Kueue and the queue management project to enable users to use Heterogeneous equipment sharing, solution and scheduling capabilities in different clusters of Scheduling systems.
s3d82e741ba256d: HAMi has been used in such settings as finance, the Internet and infrastructure for claud-native, with practices covering AI training and reference, GPU pooling, cluster resource utilization improvement and multi-tenantization.
